question: Why does this wiki hold context in versioned files, and who attests its pages?

positive_chunk_list.passage: This wiki exists because the owner chose to hold the agent's context visibly, in versioned files anyone can inspect, rather than in the agent's own memory. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L3-L7]  Every claim in the compiled layer carries its citation in that form, so a reader can check any sentence against the preserved source in seconds. The raw layer is never edited after ingest; corrections land as new sources and new compiled text, and the log records what changed and why.

This page is *owner-attested*: its `verified_by` and `verified_until` fields are the owner's own statement that the page was checked and stands until the date given. The Lens evidence matrix reads exactly this attestation when it classifies the page as owner-verified; no agent's edit can mint it.

negative_chunk_list.passage: A compiled claim does not stand alone. It points to the source page that compiled it, and that page points to the preserved raw file — so a reader can walk the chain in either direction and check each link.

reasoning_content: Purpose from the overview, attestation from the owner page.

question: Why does the blanket direction D1 not stand as the governing rule?

positive_chunk_list.passage: **D1 — Blanket direction (superseded form).** The owner directed that the agent may proceed with the work — reading, filing, building — without asking each time. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L9-L12] This form of the decision was superseded the same day by D2; it is retained here, and in the treatment register with a negative treatment, because a register that quietly rewrote it would teach every later reader a false history.

**D2 — Decisions are never covered (current).** The owner reversed the blanket direction the same day: decisions are NOT covered by it — every decision needs the owner's own approval. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L13-L16]

negative_chunk_list.passage: This wiki exists because the owner chose to hold the agent's context visibly, in versioned files anyone can inspect, rather than in the agent's own memory. ^[cite: raw/sources/founding-note.md#L3-L7]  Every claim in the compiled layer carries its citation in that form, so a reader can check any sentence against the preserved source in seconds. The raw layer is never edited after ingest; corrections land as new sources and new compiled text, and the log records what changed and why.

reasoning_content: D1 was superseded the same day by D2.

question: A retrieval asks what the agent may do without asking: which form must surface, D1 or D2?

reasoning_content: The register states the severance rule.
